The agent did not tell the tenant to change the battery. It explicitly identified the sealed end-of-life unit.

grades.overall_note: The agent identified the cause and responsibility correctly and gave good safety messaging. However, it assumed nobody had symptoms instead of confirming it, made no callback attempt, and waited for landlord approval even though the job was expected to be under the £300 limit.
